title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-LITELLM-15907616 in litellm@1.81.1
description:
## Incorrect Authorization

**Severity:** high
**Package:** litellm@1.81.1
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 8.7  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 721/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2026-35029](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-35029)

**Fix:** Upgrade `litellm` to version 1.83.0 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[litellm](https://pypi.org/project/litellm) is a Library to easily interface with LLM API providers

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Incorrect Authorization in the `/config/update` endpoint due to missing authorization checks. An attacker can modify proxy configuration, register custom endpoint handlers to execute arbitrary Python code, read arbitrary server files, and overwrite privileged account credentials by sending crafted requests to the affected endpoint. 

**Note:** 

This is only exploitable if the attacker has authenticated access to the platform.

## Workaround 

This vulnerability can be mitigated by restricting API key distribution.
## Remediation
Upgrade `litellm` to version 1.83.0 or higher.
